guidelines: This is a Laravel 12 API-only application (no Blade views)
PHP 8.4 with strict types enabled in all files
Multi-tenant architecture with tenant_id isolation via Spatie laravel-permission teams
Encryption: KEK (file) wraps DEK (per-tenant in tenant_keys table), data encrypted with tenant-specific DEK
Blind indexes: HMAC-SHA256 for searchable encrypted fields (email_idx, phone_idx)
Use libsodium for all cryptographic operations (sodium_crypto_aead_aes256gcm_* for data, sodium_crypto_secretbox_* for key wrapping)
Never expose plaintext in logs, API responses, or query parameters - use *_plain setters, hide *_enc/*_idx fields
All database queries must include tenant_id in WHERE clause for isolation
Use Repository Pattern for data access (PersonRepository)
PEST for testing with Feature/Unit split - use RefreshDatabase trait
Laravel Pint (PSR-12) for code style, PHPStan Level Max for static analysis
All routes require authentication (Sanctum) and authorization (Spatie permissions)
REUSE compliance: SPDX headers in all source files (AGPL-3.0-or-later for code, CC0-1.0 for config/docs)
Commands must have --force flag, progress bars, confirmation prompts, and comprehensive logging
Follow Laravel Best Practices: Service Container, Facades, Eloquent ORM, no raw SQL unless necessary
